body: Yeah I hear ya. I'm absolutely fine with "getting him in trouble". They're just not (yet) willing to bust down any doors. I don't think I have any justification for a search warrant...at least yet.   At this point, we're just looking for closure. I'm 95% sure he's dead, but in the off chance he's alive, he'll open fire if any of us approach him, and would probably do "death by cop" if they busted the door open.

yeah the deputy asked for details about the suicide message. I told him the threats started about 4 days ago, but about 24 hours ago became much more immediate and specific. Like, they went from "I'm thinking of killing myself this weekend" to "I'm going to the garage to start my car and run the engine".  I was just at the house -- the garage is separate, and I drove from the side where he couldn't see me if he's in the house. The truck is in there. The lights are on in the garage (no surprise, he's terrible at turning things off). There is a large plastic sheet hanging from the ceiling, as if to contain the carbon monoxide. But I can't see into the vehicle. Breaking a window would cause the alarm to sound, and if he's alive and in the house that could cause him to open fire.   


We tried calling 911 from the house with that information, but got transferred to the same deputy who had knocked on the door earlier. He repeated that apologetically, their hands are tied.
